description: Change a shift — reassign it, move it, change position or notes. When I Work requires start_time, end_time and location_id on every update, so fetch the shift first and pass them back. This tool never sends a breaks array; When I Work documents that breaks omitted from an update's breaks list are removed, so re-check the shift's breaks afterwards. When I Work: PUT /2/shifts/{id}.

break_time.description: Unpaid break length in hours, e.g. 0.5.

end_time.description: Shift end (required by the API even if unchanged).

is_shared.description: For an open shift: a shared open shift.

notes.description: Shift notes shown to the employee.

start_time.description: Shift start (required by the API even if unchanged).

user_id.description: The user to assign. 0 (or omitted on create) makes it an open shift.

name: wheniwork_update_shift
title: Update a shift
